title: Mini Soulgazer Lengthening Mascara + Lash Serum in 1 for Sensitive Eyes

specifications.ingredientPreferences: crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree, peptides

descriptionHtml:
✓ Peptide✓ Long-wearing✓ Lengthening✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Hypoallergenic✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A lengthening mascara that builds without clumping, powered by a lash-boosting peptide serum for visibly longer, fuller lashes in six to eight weeks. Safe for sensitive eyes.

Formulation Type: Lengthening


Benefits: Long-wearing


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17: Supports visibly longer, fuller lashes in six to eight weeks.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is gluten-free, and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Starting with the brush held horizontally, press lightly at the base of the lashes, wiggle, and pull upward.
-Repeat as desired to coat, lengthen, and lift every lash.
-Use daily for six to eight weeks to see visibly fuller, longer bare lashes.
-Results may vary by individual.

Hot tips:
-For max length and volume, apply to both the tops and bottoms of lashes.
-To layer, use the tip of the brush and swipe upward.
-Add as a topper to any other mascara for incredible length.
-For more volume, swirl your brush in the tube before applying to allow for more product to be deposited on the brush.
-Soulgazer can be "reactivated" easily. Add another layer anytime during the day to refresh or go from casual to nighttime glam.
Ingredients+
-Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17: Supports visibly longer, fuller lashes in six to eight weeks.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Stearic Acid, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/ Cire de Carnauba, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Myrica Pubescens Fruit Wax, Pullulan, Aminomethyl Propanediol, Oleic/Linoleic/Linolenic Polyglycerides, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Galactoarabinan, Xanthan Gum, Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Hydroxyacetophenone.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
